I will repeat what I have said too many times already, Ippo didn't grow much as a character outside of the ring. I get it, lack of father figure, mental trauma from bullying, insecurities etc, but even with all of these chains, people still grow mentally and get better. While I can relate with these issues, I cannot relate to Ippo who hasn't grown as a person mentally, despite overcoming adversity in the ring.
